from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EPSRecord(BaseModel):
    """One EPS finding from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as it appears in the filing")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g. 'Three months ended March 31, 2024')")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The label of the EPS line item (e.g. 'Basic income per share', 'Basic loss per share')")
    eps_value: float | None = Field(description="The numerical EPS value; negative for loss if reported")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the EPS figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    eps_records: list[EPSRecord]
